steps.text: MSI installs silently via msiexec /i ... /qn. The launcher UI is heavy CEF; first start takes minutes. -SkipBuildPatchPrereq avoids a prerequisite loop under Wine.

knownIssues.cause: Epic's embedded Chromium webview renders black under DXMT
knownIssues.fix: the launcher pin now runs under DXVK (games in the bottle still use the bottle's renderer)

knownIssues.symptom: Launcher downloads its own update, then closes and nothing happens
knownIssues.cause: Epic's self-update restart doesn't survive Wine
knownIssues.fix: open Epic again from the bottle; it resumes where it left off

knownIssues.symptom: Installing any game fails with 'You do not have permission to install to...' (DP-07), regardless of folder
knownIssues.cause: Epic audits Windows file permissions after its helper grants them and Wine cannot satisfy the audit (log shows 'Authorize success without gaining access'); no install folder avoids it
knownIssues.fix: none inside the launcher; a direct install path for Epic games (Legendary-style) is planned, tracked in highball issue 14

lastVerified.result: launcher UI renders correctly with the DXVK pin (black under DXMT); self-update downloads and applies but needs a manual relaunch; game-install DP-07 not yet reproduced locally
